details: The latest US Non-Farm Payrolls (NFP) report for August revealed the creation of over 160,000 jobs, significantly surpassing market expectations. This robust labor market performance has intensified speculation about a more aggressive stance from the Federal Reserve, potentially leading to further interest rate hikes to curb inflation. Consequently, investor confidence in risk assets, including cryptocurrencies, has shown signs of weakening, with a possible shift of capital towards more stable, lower-risk investments.
title: Strong US Jobs Data Boosts Fed Hike Bets, Dulls Crypto Confidence

details: The US Treasury recently increased the maximum size of its long-term bond buyback operations, aiming to enhance market liquidity. Simultaneously, minutes from the Federal Reserve's latest meeting indicated that some officials are still considering additional interest rate increases if inflation does not recede. This contrasting approach—the Treasury injecting liquidity while the Fed contemplates tighter monetary policy—creates a complex macroeconomic environment. Elevated real yields, influenced by potential Fed actions, are increasing the opportunity cost of holding non-yield-bearing assets like Bitcoin, making traditional investments relatively more attractive.
title: Divergence in US Fed and Treasury Policy Impacts Bitcoin's Opportunity Cost

details: The cryptocurrency market is keenly awaiting crucial US inflation reports next week, including the Producer Price Index (PPI) on September 10 and the Consumer Price Index (CPI) on September 11. These economic indicators will be pivotal in shaping market expectations for the Federal Reserve's monetary policy, particularly regarding future interest rate decisions. The outcome of these inflation figures is anticipated to have a significant impact on the valuations of risk assets, including cryptocurrencies, ahead of the Federal Reserve's policy meeting scheduled for September 15-16.
title: Upcoming US Inflation Data Crucial for Crypto Valuations
